verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a SaaS legal-services platform like LegalZoom, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an API, endpoints, or developer docs. The only machine-facing artifact is an llms.txt file offering guidance to AI crawlers, which is adjacent content guidance rather than a way to drive the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
